parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: Enter the ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance to which the transit router belongs.

parameters.name: CenOwnerId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the CEN instance belongs.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the network instance.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of network instance. Valid values:

*   **VPC**: VPC
*   **ExpressConnect**: VBR
*   **VPN**: IPsec-VPN connection
*   **ECR**: ECR

parameters.name: OrderType
parameters.description:
The entity that pays the fees of the network instance. Valid values:

*   **PayByCenOwner**: the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the CEN instance.
*   **PayByResourceOwner**: the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the network instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the network instance is deployed.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn grant-instance-to-transit-router --cen-id cen-44m0p68spvlrqq0000 --instance-id vpc-bp1h8vbrbcgohcju50000 --instance-type VPC --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cen-owner-id 1250123456123456 --order-type PayByCenOwner --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cbn GrantInstanceToTransitRouter --region cn-hangzhou --OrderType PayByCenOwner --InstanceId 'vpc-bp1h8vbrbcgohcju50000' --CenOwnerId 1250123456123456 --CenId 'cen-44m0p68spvlrqq0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceType VPC
